columns.name: Piece Name
columns.helperText: Name of artwork goes here

columns.name: Inventory Number
columns.helperText: Leave blank unless you have your own inventory or ID system

columns.name: Medium
columns.helperText: Medium information goes here

columns.name: Type
columns.helperText: USE ONE OF THE FOLLOWING: Book, Ceramic, Collage, Digital, Drawing, Fiber, Film/Video, Furniture, Garment, Glass, Illustration, Installation, Jewelry, Metalwork, Mixed Media, Mosaic, Mural, New Media, Other, Painting, Performance, Photography, Print, Sculpture, Textile, Wood, Work on Paper

columns.name: Status
columns.helperText: USE ONE OF THE FOLLOWING: in_progress, available, reserved, donated, gifted, sold, not_for_sale, on_loan, installed, in_storage, in_transit, under_maintenance, work_destroyed, lost, stolen, deaccessioned, returned_to_owner

columns.name: Height
columns.helperText: Enter Number Only: default is inches.  Specify if cm

columns.name: Width
columns.helperText: Enter Number Only: default is inches.  Specify if cm

columns.name: Depth
columns.helperText: Enter Number Only: default is inches.  Specify if cm

columns.name: Dimension Override
columns.helperText: Use this if your dimensions do not fit into h/w/d format. This can be any text string such as "12 inch diameter"

columns.name: Paper Height
columns.helperText: Enter Number Only: default is inches.  Specify if cm

columns.name: Paper Width
columns.helperText: Enter Number Only: default is inches.  Specify if cm

columns.name: Framed
columns.helperText: Mark Yes or No

columns.name: Framed Height
columns.helperText: Enter Number Only: default is inches.  Specify if cm

columns.name: Framed Width
columns.helperText: Enter Number Only: default is inches.  Specify if cm

columns.name: Framed Depth
columns.helperText: Enter Number Only: default is inches.  Specify if cm

columns.name: Subject Matter
columns.helperText: Enter subject matter here

columns.name: Price
columns.helperText: Add retail price here

columns.name: Fair Market Value
columns.helperText: Add FMV here

columns.name: Wholesale Value
columns.helperText: Add wholesale price here

columns.name: Insurance Value
columns.helperText: Add inurance value here

columns.name: Creation Date
columns.helperText: Date work was created  Format as:mm/dd/yyyy. If just year use yyyy

columns.name: Circa
columns.helperText: If the date is Circa, mark yes here

columns.name: Creation date override
columns.helperText: Use this if you want the creation date to display something other than a year. For exmaple "19th Century"

columns.name: Description
columns.helperText: Description of the artwork goes here

columns.name: Tags
columns.helperText: Comma separated list of Tags

columns.name: Collections
columns.helperText: Comma separated list of collections

columns.name: Current Location Name
columns.helperText: This is where the work is currently located. This is NOT where you enter who you sold the work to.  That is done in later columns

columns.name: Current Location Start Date
columns.helperText: Format as:mm/dd/yyyy. If just year use yyyy

columns.name: Current Location End Date
columns.helperText: Format as:mm/dd/yyyy. If just year use yyyy

columns.name: Sub Location Name
columns.helperText: Only available for Organization accounts

columns.name: Tertiary Location Name
columns.helperText: Only available for Organization accounts

columns.name: Location Record Notes
columns.helperText: Notes on this location record

columns.name: Location Record Longitude
columns.helperText: Only available for Organization accounts. Only enter if GPS location is different from the location address

columns.name: Location Record Latitude
columns.helperText: Only available for Organization accounts. Only enter if GPS location is different from the location address

columns.name: Sale/Donation/Gift
columns.helperText: *Only use if you or your organization sold/donated/gifted the work.This is used to capture sales, donations and giftings of your work.  The options for this column are "sale", "donation", "gift" or leave blank.

columns.name: Sale Location
columns.helperText: If sold from a location, you can list that here.

columns.name: Sale/Donation/Gift Date
columns.helperText: Format as:mm/dd/yyyy. If just year use yyyy

columns.name: Sale/Donation/Gift Price
columns.helperText: Amount the work was sold for

columns.name: Sale Discount
columns.helperText: Discount off the sale price (In currency units)

columns.name: Sale Commission
columns.helperText: Commission taken off the sale price (In currency units)

columns.name: First Name/Company Name of who you sold/donated/gifted to
columns.helperText: Use this to record the first name or company name of the buyer or recipient

columns.name: Last Name of who you sold/donated/gifted to
columns.helperText: Use this to record the last name of the buyer or recipient

columns.name: Acquisition: Purchase Price
columns.helperText: Amount the work was purchased for

columns.name: Acquisition: Purchase Date
columns.helperText: Date work was purchased: mm/dd/yyyy

columns.name: Acquisition: Purchase Location
columns.helperText: The name of the location that you purchased the work

columns.name: Acquisition:  Purchase from First Name/Company Name
columns.helperText: The first name or company name of who you purchased from

columns.name: Acquisition: Purchase From Last Name
columns.helperText: The last name of the person you purchased from

columns.name: Acquisition: Donation Date
columns.helperText: Date work was donated to you: mm/dd/yyyy

columns.name: Acquisition: Donation Value
columns.helperText: Value of donated work.

columns.name: Acquisition: Donor First Name/Company Name
columns.helperText: The first name or company name of the person who donated this to you.

columns.name: Acquisition: Donor Last
columns.helperText: Last name of the person or company who donated this to you.

columns.name: Attribution Line
columns.helperText: Place to acknowledge the donation or gift. Example: In memory of John Smith

columns.name: Signed
columns.helperText: Mark Yes or No

columns.name: Signature Notes
columns.helperText: Details on where the signature is located.

columns.name: Edition
columns.helperText: Mark yes if this work is part of an Edition

columns.name: Edition Info
columns.helperText: Provide edition related details here (i.e. 1/10)

columns.name: Appraisal Date
columns.helperText: Date of the appraisal: mm/dd/yyyy

columns.name: Appraisal Value
columns.helperText: Price of appraisal

columns.name: Appraiser First Name
columns.helperText: First name of appraiser goas here

columns.name: Appraiser Last Name
columns.helperText: Last name of appraiser goes here

columns.name: Condition Status
columns.helperText: Use one of the following:Excellent, Good, Fair, Poor, Very Poor

columns.name: Condition Notes
columns.helperText: Detailed condition notes go here

columns.name: Weight
columns.helperText: Weight of piece

columns.name: Provenance
columns.helperText: The history of ownership for this work of art.

columns.name: Piece Image Filename or URL
columns.helperText: Add the FULL filename or URL path to the image file.  NOTE: You can add up to 30 additional Image filenames or URLs in this column separated by pipe character "|". The first image listed will be the Primary Image for your piece record.

columns.name: Additional File Filename or URL
columns.helperText: Add the FULL filename or URL path. Multiple URLs in this column should be separated by pipe character "|".
